title: Nets Full of Fish
reflectionQuestion: Peter was tired and his nets were empty, but he trusted Jesus and tried once more. I wonder what it would feel like to trust Jesus, even when you feel tired or unsure?
kidSafetyNotes: NEW anchor (Jesus' Miracles). Phase 2 'Beloved': the empty-nets -> overflowing-boats arc is the big visual payoff (nets tearing, boats nearly sinking). Room = trust Jesus' word even when you are tired / from empty to overflowing. Peter's honest tiredness + doubt ('we worked all night and caught nothing') makes the trust real and relatable ('but if you say so'). Distinct from 1804 Jesus Walks on the Water (no walking/sinking here). Soft close ('overflowing'). VOICE_NOAH_PATIENT (patient, steady -- fits the all-night fisherman).

scriptureKeyVerse.text: Simon answered him, “Master, we worked all night and caught nothing; but at your word I will let down the net.”
